title: EleutherIA: An AI-Powered Scholarly Research Platform for Ancient Philosophy on Free Will
description: EleutherIA is an AI-powered scholarly research platform combining a FAIR-compliant knowledge graph, an ancient texts corpus, and an agentic GraphRAG engine to document ancient philosophical debates on free will, fate, and moral responsibility from the Greco-Roman and Early Christian periods. The main branch cites the stable Zenodo concept DOI; release-specific DOIs are minted automatically from tagged GitHub releases.

creators.name: Girardi, Romain
creators.affiliation: Universite Cote d'Azur, CEPAM; Universite de Geneve, Faculte de Theologie Jean Calvin
